person_note: The eligible prose novel is controlled throughout by Landon Carter, who narrates as a participating first-person speaker from a retrospective frame and recounts his seventeenth year. Numerous event quotes independently expose this I/we voice, while the authorized opening excerpt and whole-book scholarly structural analysis agree. Second-person forms are reader address, dialogue, or universal maxims rather than sustained narration of a protagonist as you. Script-form film quotations, Jamie's speech, biblical passages, and Landon's locally quoted speech were treated as non-base evidence. No credible source indicated sustained third- or second-person sections; the only minor uncertainty is contamination of the Goodreads set by adaptation dialogue, which does not affect the strongly established book-level classification.
